title: Calculation precision, tax rounding and settlement rounding are separate layers
summary: Accounting Core deliberately separates high-precision calculation from tax rounding and from settlement rounding. A jurisdiction tax policy chooses how and when a fractional tax result becomes legal whole minor units; a separate settlement policy may later alter the amount actually paid without rewriting the tax determination.
invariants: Tax arithmetic can retain an exact rational numerator/denominator; ledger postings remain exact whole minor units.
A tax election carries the exact rounding algorithm reference and calculation granularity applicable to that tax registration and period.
Settlement rounding begins from an already-accounted obligation and produces a separate signed rounding difference.
Settlement tender applicability is explicit; Accounting Core never assumes cash-only rounding.
Neutral rounding primitives are mechanics, not law. A jurisdiction policy decides whether HALF_UP, HALF_EVEN, TRUNCATE, FLOOR, CEILING or another method is legally appropriate.
A settlement adjustment must never change the tax amount that was already legally determined.

provenance.claim: Tax calculations may retain exact rational sub-minor-unit amounts and jurisdiction policy selects legal rounding.
Settlement rounding is independent of tax rounding, has explicit tender applicability and cannot rewrite determined tax.
